title: Te Kaikawe i te Karere Urupā
intro: I tonoa mai he wairua tika hei ārahi i tētahi iwi kua ngaro i roto i ngā hara o mua. I tū pakari tēnei karere, me te tuku i tētahi whakatūpato pakari mō te pirau e whakahē ana i te tikanga o te taiao. Ahakoa ngā tono nui, i ruku hohonu atu te hapori ki roto i te pōuri, me te whakatakoto i te tūāpapa mō tētahi whakatau a te Atua, he rerekē i tētahi atu. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei pononga pono a Allah?
clues: He whanaunga ahau nō tētahi atu poropiti nui, ā, i heke tahi māua, ka whakarērea tō mātou whenua tupu.
I tonoa ahau ki tētahi iwi he ahurei tō rātou kino, he hara kāore anō kia mahia e tētahi mea hanga i mua i a rātou.
I wehewehea tōku ake whare; i piri puku tetahi o ngā whanaunga tata ki te hunga whakateka.
I haere mai ngā anahera, i roto i te āhua o ngā taitama ātaahua, ki tōku kāinga hei manuhiri, ā, i tino mamae ahau mō tō rātou haumaru.
I tukua e ahau aku tamahine ki te wahine ma taku iwi, he mea kia tahuri ke ai ratou i a ratou mahi whakama.
I whakangaromia tōku iwi e te aue nui, me te ua o ngā kōhatu paru tunutunu, ko mātou ko tōku whānau ia, engari kotahi, i whakaorangia mā te wehenga atu i te pō.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Poropiti Shu'ayb
Poropiti Salih
Poropiti Ruta
Poropiti a Hūta
Poropiti a Noa

trial.label: He aha taku Whakamātautau Matua?
options: Te whakatenatena i tētahi kīngi nanakia kia kaua ahau e tahuna ki te ahi.
Te whakatau i te hae o ōku tuakana, me te makanga ki roto i te puna.
Te tū atu ki tētahi iwi e mahi ana i ngā mahi moepuku kāore i kitea i mua.
Te ārahi i taku iwi i waho i te herekoretanga mai i te ringa o tētahi Parao mana nui.
Te hanga i tētahi kaipuke nui hei whakaora i te hunga whakapono i tētahi waipuke nui.
trial.answer: Te tū atu ki tētahi iwi e mahi ana i ngā mahi moepuku kāore i kitea i mua.

location.label: I hea te wāhi i tū ai taku misioni?
options: Te tāone o Madyan
Te tāone tawhito o Iram
Te whenua o Ihipa i raro i a Parao
Ngā tāone o Horoma rāua ko Komora
Te tāone o Ninewe
location.answer: Ngā tāone o Horoma rāua ko Komora

outcome.label: He aha te hua whakamutunga?
options: I hurihia ngā tāone, ā, i ringihia ki ngā kōhatu paru i tunua.
I horomia taku iwi e te whenua me tō rātou rangatira whai rawa.
I whakangaromia tōku iwi e te hau nui mō ngā pō e whitu me ngā rā e waru.
I pāngia tōku iwi e ngā mate urutā pērā i te mawhitiwhiti, te kutu, me te poroka.
I horomia ahau e tētahi ika nui i muri i taku whakarēreatanga o taku misioni.
outcome.answer: I hurihia ngā tāone, ā, i ringihia ki ngā kōhatu paru i tunua.

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
verse: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were] (11:82)
